data.title: Real-Time Face/Voice Changer Detection During Video Interview
data.description: Detect real-time face and voice changing artifacts during video conferencing sessions: (1) virtual camera driver interception via OBS Virtual Camera, ManyCam, or DeepFaceLive, (2) audio spectral anomalies indicating synthetic voice generation or unnatural formant transitions, (3) temporal inconsistencies between lip movement and audio exceeding 200ms delta. These techniques are used by DPRK IT workers and other threat actors to impersonate identities during remote hiring interviews and ongoing employment.

enrichment_required.source: Audio analysis enrichment (spectral anomaly detection scoring)

queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Real-Time Face/Voice Changer Detection During Video Interview")`
`comment("Native query required - audio/video analysis cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
index=flame_collaboration sourcetype=flame:video_conferencing
(camera_driver_name="*OBS Virtual*" OR camera_driver_name="*ManyCam*" OR camera_driver_name="*DeepFace*" OR camera_driver_name="*FaceSwap*")
OR audio_analysis_score>0.75
OR lip_sync_delta_ms>200
| eval risk_score=case(
    camera_driver_name LIKE "%DeepFace%" OR camera_driver_name LIKE "%FaceSwap%", 90,
    camera_driver_name LIKE "%OBS Virtual%" OR camera_driver_name LIKE "%ManyCam%", 50,
    audio_analysis_score>0.75, 80,
    lip_sync_delta_ms>200, 70)
| where risk_score>=50
| stats count values(camera_driver_name) as cameras values(audio_analysis_score) as audio_scores max(lip_sync_delta_ms) as max_lip_delta by user_id session_id

falsepositives: Legitimate OBS usage for screen sharing or streaming
Virtual background applications using camera driver interception
Legitimate audio processing software for noise cancellation
Poor network conditions causing audio-video desynchronization
